subject: SCCs & DPA: jurisdictional bridging, delegation language, and evidence pack
messages:
From: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>
To: Bridgewell Pharma <legal@bridgewell.com>, Bridgewell Procurement <procurement@bridgewell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: SCCs & DPA: jurisdictional bridging, delegation language, and evidence pack

Hi Elaine / Bridgewell team,

Thanks for the productive call last week. As discussed, attaching our proposed DPA (Redwood_DPA_v1.docx) and an evidence_manifest.xlsx that lists the items you asked for (SOC 2 report pointers, subprocessor roster, KMS attestations, and flow diagrams).

Three asks to keep this moving:
- Can you confirm whether Bridgewell requires the new EU SCCs plus the transfer impact addendum, or if the legacy SCCs (with the addendum) are sufficient for procurement?
- We included a delegation clause that keeps controller/processor roles aligned to the Order Form; please flag any redline language that would change role allocation at a jurisdictional level.
- Please indicate which evidence items you need before signature vs. which can be delivered post-signature in a defined timeline. The attached manifest tags each item with "pre-sign" or "post-sign".

Ben and Laura are copied for legal/ops coordination. Happy to take a 45m call tomorrow afternoon to walk the marked-up DPA if that helps. Proposed slots: 2:00pm or 3:30pm PT.

Attachments: Redwood_DPA_v1.docx (draft), evidence_manifest.xlsx

Thanks,
Rachel Kim
Senior Legal Operations Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Elaine Hutton <elaine@huttonlaw.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Bridgewell Pharma <legal@bridgewell.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCCs & DPA: jurisdictional bridging, delegation language, and evidence pack

Rachel / team,

Thanks for the draft. I reviewed Redwood_DPA_v1 and attached a marked-up version (Bridgewell_DPA_markedup.docx) with three high-level notes upfront:

1) Roles & Delegation: we need explicit language that Bridgewell remains Controller w.r.t. customer data, and Redwood is Processor. The current delegation clause reads as if either party could opt into processor responsibilities at a regional level — please tighten so any role re-allocation requires written amendment to the Order Form.

2) SCCs & Transfer Addendum: Bridgewell prefers the new EU SCCs (2021 standard) + a short transfer-impact addendum that captures onshore processing exceptions for a limited set of AWS-hosted telemetry (listed in the addendum). If Redwood needs to rely on fallback routing (e.g., US backup region), we need a cross-reference to the evidence manifest and a SLO for notice and mitigation.

3) Evidence & KMS: procurement wants KMS key residency and HSM details on pre-sign evidence. Also request a sample audit log export (redacted) to validate retention/rotation statements. If Redwood cannot provide a redacted sample pre-sign, call this out and propose an alternative acceptance test post-signature.

I've inserted suggested phrasing in the marked-up doc for the Controller/Processor sentence and a short paragraph that binds fallback routing to a documented mitigation plan.

Next step: I'm available for a call tomorrow at 3:30pm PT to walk through margin edits if that works — otherwise feel free to send a counter-proposal in track changes.

Attachment: Bridgewell_DPA_markedup.docx

Best,
Elaine Hutton
Partner, Hutton & Co.
Elaine@huttonlaw.com

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Elaine Hutton <elaine@huttonlaw.com>, Bridgewell Pharma <legal@bridgewell.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 13:20:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCCs & DPA: jurisdictional bridging, delegation language, and evidence pack

Thanks Elaine — helpful markup. Quick responses inline:

On Sun, 30 May 2027 at 11:03 AM Elaine Hutton <elaine@huttonlaw.com> wrote:
> 1) Roles & Delegation: we need explicit language that Bridgewell remains Controller...

Agreed on locked-in controller/processor language. We can accept language that requires an Order Form amendment for any role change. I'll circulate a narrow clause for Laura to sign off (one paragraph).

> 2) SCCs & Transfer Addendum: Bridgewell prefers the new EU SCCs (2021 standard) + addendum...

Redwood is fine with the new SCCs. The only ask from our infra team: if onshore exceptions list grows beyond the documented set we need a capacity-and-cost trigger (so we don't silently escalate infra costs). Suggest adding a short sentence linking any expansion to an SLA and a pricing trigger.

> 3) Evidence & KMS: procurement wants KMS key residency and HSM details on pre-sign evidence.

We can provide KMS key residencies and an HSM architecture diagram pre-sign. For redacted audit log exports we can provide a scoped extract (first 14 days) in our evidence drive; full exports will be available post-sign under the evidence timeline. Marking those items as either pre-sign or T+30 in the manifest.

Propose we take Laura's clause + my infra note into the 3:30pm call and close the DPA this week.

Ben Carter
Senior Product Counsel, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Rachel Kim <rachel_kim@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>

Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 15:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: SCCs & DPA: jurisdictional bridging, delegation language, and evidence pack

Team — summary and actions (so procurement/legal have a single checklist):

1) Roles: Redwood will update the DPA to include a concise amendment-only redline for role re-allocation. Rachel to load new draft into the shared Drive.
2) SCCs: we will adopt the new EU SCCs. Elaine — please confirm the final addendum text on the call.
3) Evidence: Redwood to upload the KMS residency map, HSM architecture diagram, and a 14-day redacted audit extract to the Drive folder before EOD tomorrow. Items labelled pre-sign in evidence_manifest.xlsx must be delivered prior to signature; the rest will be delivered T+30 with acceptance criteria.
4) Pricing/ops trigger: Ben will add a 1–2 sentence clause tying expansion of onshore processing exceptions to a pricing/capacity trigger.
5) Call: confirmed 3:30pm PT today. Dial-in + materials in Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-bridgewell-evidence
6) DocuSign: we will prepare the DocuSign envelope once the marked-up DPA is reconciled — https://www.docusign.com/redirect?token=abc123-bridgewell-dpa

Rachel — can you please add procurement owner email (procurement@bridgewell.com) to the manifest and move the marked-up doc into the Drive? After the call I'll draft the final signoff note for exec review.

Thanks all,
